correctness.rationale: The away-step bounds are inactive near the interior minimizer, giving explicit smooth projected Jacobian factors. A recurrence for coordinates before their elimination yields both necessity and sufficiency of the polynomial eigen-equation and simple-root count; all nontrivial roots are inside the unit disk. A locally uniform binomial-to-exponential limit, Rouché/Hurwitz arguments and an explicit ordering of Lambert branches give the exact dimension limit. Symbolic characteristic polynomials n=3..8 and 70 finite-difference Jacobian checks reproduced from the embedded verifier. Limits: local and exact arithmetic only.

value.rationale: Vertex-cyclic away-step descent is a motivated algorithm with published global linear bounds. On the canonical isotropic simplex, the exact all-dimensional local iteration spectrum specifies precise decay and oscillatory modes, and the nonzero limiting rate 0.123830... is an algorithmic dimension-scaling benchmark absent from coarse generic bounds. The change to conjugate eigenmodes already at four vertices is structural, not a routine one-dimensional test.
